title: Automated Compliance Audit for Legacy Client Portals
business: Financial services firms maintaining legacy web portals that lack modern APIs for data verification.
problem: Manual verification of regulatory disclosures across hundreds of client accounts is error-prone, labor-intensive, and fails to scale during quarterly audit cycles.
solution: By integrating the Playwright MCP server, Claude can programmatically traverse the legacy portal, interact with DOM elements via the accessibility tree, and extract verification data without manual human intervention.
steps: Define the target URL and authentication credentials within the secure MCP configuration.
Instruct Claude to navigate to the client disclosure page using the Playwright browser automation tools.
Execute a script to locate specific disclosure checkboxes and text fields using accessibility tree selectors.
Capture the state of the compliance confirmation and generate a PDF report for the audit trail.
outcome: Increased audit consistency and significant reduction in manual labor, allowing compliance officers to focus on exception handling rather than repetitive data entry.
limitation: The solution relies on the accessibility tree structure; if the legacy portal undergoes a UI redesign that alters the DOM hierarchy without updating ARIA labels, the automation scripts will fail. Verify this by checking for console error messages or failed element lookups during the initial navigation step.
